The installer now makes JDownloader ad-free as well as dark.

## Added

- **Ad-free out of the box.** The installer now also switches off JDownloader's built-in advertisements: the bottom **"Become premium user" banner** (which squeezed the download graph's height), the **premium-alert** column nags, the status-bar **"+ premium"** button, and the **special-deal** popups. It writes these `false` flags into `org.jdownloader.settings.GraphicalUserInterfaceSettings.json` alongside the existing `lookandfeeltheme: FLATLAF_DARK`. Advertisements only — the Donate button and every functional setting are left untouched. (Re-enable any of them under Settings → Advanced Settings if you want them back; the keys stay as written.)

## Notes

- Still plain configuration: **no patched `flatlaf.jar`, no Java agent**, survives JDownloader self-updates.
- Re-run the installer (or pick `FLATLAF_DARK` once) to apply. Existing config is preserved.
